defects: The largest text ('UNITED ARAB EMIRATES') is country-only, lacking a direct, candidate-facing opportunity+destination hook—'CONSTRUCTION WELDER JOBS – UAE' or similar would be a stronger lead.
Visual hierarchy is slightly confusing: strong country headline overshadows the actual job opportunity, which is buried mid-ad.
CTA (email, phone) is visible but lacks emphasis and is less prominent than primary content.
Agency/trust identity is present at the bottom but visually disconnected by the large block above—could be more integrated.
There is a moderately large underutilized white canvas block at bottom right (QR band) that disrupts flow and is out of proportion to the information it contains.
Yellow on white for phone number in the CTA footer is hard to read and lacks sufficient contrast.
Typography for benefits and contact details is minimally sized; could be increased for mobile legibility.

requiredCorrections.note: The role/destination hook ('Welders Required – Abu Dhabi') should be the single largest and most attention-getting line, not just the country name.
Contact line (email/phone) and QR code need bolder, higher-contrast presentation and more prominence to serve as an effective CTA, especially on mobile.
The QR/CTA footer area uses a large white block that feels imbalanced relative to other content; it could be made less obtrusive or better integrated to utilize space without disrupting layout.
Yellow-gold text for contact number is low-contrast on a white band, reducing legibility.
